stem.text: Which statement about the first ionisation energies of magnesium and neon is correct?

A.text: Magnesium has the greater numerical value and both are endothermic.

B.text: Magnesium has the greater numerical value and both are exothermic.

C.text: Neon has the greater numerical value and both are endothermic.

D.text: Neon has the greater numerical value and both are exothermic.
